title: GOES 氣象觀測衛星

summaryEn: Estimate cloud-top cooling rate and detect timestamp errors or mismatched cloud tracking.
scope: 本課採用原創紙面、試算表或離線模型練習。案例來源用於查證背景；數值、擾動及驗收門檻是明示的教學假設，不是設備規格、製程配方、臨床操作或飛行程序。實作成果是可重算的分析紀錄。

References establish case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and acceptance limits are stated teaching assumptions, not equipment specifications, production recipes, clinical instructions, or flight procedures. Deliver reproducible analysis records.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: GOES 從地球同步軌道提供連續氣象影像，快速序列可追蹤雲頂演變。
knowledge.textEn: GOES supplies repeated weather imagery from geostationary orbit, enabling cloud-top evolution studies.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 用影像時間序列估計雲頂降溫率，辨識時間戳錯位與雲體追蹤錯配。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate cloud-top cooling rate and detect timestamp errors or mismatched cloud tracking.

knowledge.title: 物理模型與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 有限差分 dT/dt≈(T₂−T₁)/(t₂−t₁) 需追蹤同一雲體；亮溫不是直接的雲頂實際溫度。
knowledge.textEn: Finite difference dT/dt≈(T₂−T₁)/(t₂−t₁) requires the same cloud object; brightness temperature is not automatically physical cloud-top temperature.

quiz.question: 「時間與雲體識別」：哪一項指出本課需保留的異常機制或替代解釋，不能直接當成驗收成功？
quiz.questionEn: Time and cloud identity: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: 全段率 (242−250)/10=−0.8 K/min；前後半段分別 −0.6、−1.0，單一平均掩蓋加速。
交付帶取得時間的雲體軌跡、斜率表與需人工複查的片段。
若所有雲體同時出現階躍，檢查校準或時標；只有一個追蹤框突變，檢查雲體關聯。
optionsEn: Whole-interval rate=(242−250)/10=−0.8 K/min; halves are −0.6 and −1.0, so one average hides acceleration.
Deliver acquisition-timed cloud tracks, rate tables and intervals requiring review.
A simultaneous step in all clouds suggests calibration or timing; a jump in one track suggests association error.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。若所有雲體同時出現階躍，檢查校準或時標；只有一個追蹤框突變，檢查雲體關聯。 與本階段判準一起判讀：變化率使用取得時間，延遲另列。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. A simultaneous step in all clouds suggests calibration or timing; a jump in one track suggests association error. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Rates use acquisition time; latency is recorded separately.

steps.title: 時間與雲體識別 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Time and cloud identity · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「時間與雲體識別」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Time and cloud identity and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
若所有雲體同時出現階躍，檢查校準或時標；只有一個追蹤框突變，檢查雲體關聯。
對照「時間與雲體識別」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。本課門檻只標示需檢視的合成訊號，不能直接發布天氣警報；保留追蹤信心。
本階段必須重驗：變化率使用取得時間，延遲另列。
steps.instructionEn:
A simultaneous step in all clouds suggests calibration or timing; a jump in one track suggests association error.
Against the nominal Time and cloud identity result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. The teaching threshold flags synthetic data for review, not a weather warning; retain tracking confidence.
Reverify this criterion: Rates use acquisition time; latency is recorded separately.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。若所有雲體同時出現階躍，檢查校準或時標；只有一個追蹤框突變，檢查雲體關聯。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. A simultaneous step in all clouds suggests calibration or timing; a jump in one track suggests association error.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 變化率使用取得時間，延遲另列。
steps.checkEn: Rates use acquisition time; latency is recorded separately.

steps.title: 時間與雲體識別 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Time and cloud identity · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「時間與雲體識別」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Time and cloud identity and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付帶取得時間的雲體軌跡、斜率表與需人工複查的片段。
在交接件中加入「時間與雲體識別」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：變化率使用取得時間，延遲另列。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：用影像時間序列估計雲頂降溫率，辨識時間戳錯位與雲體追蹤錯配。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver acquisition-timed cloud tracks, rate tables and intervals requiring review.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Time and cloud identity: Rates use acquisition time; latency is recorded separately.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Estimate cloud-top cooling rate and detect timestamp errors or mismatched cloud tracking. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。變化率使用取得時間，延遲另列。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Rates use acquisition time; latency is recorded separately.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
